source_obligations.statement: Allocate at most one dimension-compliant ordinary bag as the free carry-on.

Apply first, second, third, and fourth-plus base fees in the order bags become checked bags.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Compute each checked bag's size as length plus width plus height.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When a checked bag is both oversize and overweight, add only the higher excess fee to its base checked-bag fee.
